Develop a reusable strategy for playing an entire game of Snake, from the opening until the game ends. The attached image illustrates only the game's visual appearance and symbols. It is not the current game state and must not determine a fixed route, target location, or opening action. Your strategy must remain applicable as the snake moves and grows and new food appears. Describe how to interpret each latest screenshot, apply turns relative to the current heading, avoid collisions and repetitive loops, and pursue food while preserving room to move. After your reasoning, summarize the whole-game strategy in a concise plan. This summary limits the length of your explanation, not the number of game steps it covers.<turn|>
